long_biography.plain_text:
Associated Shipbroking built its business around following maritime transactions from early design and yard selection through negotiation, finance and delivery. Co-founder James Patrick McLoughlin helped shape the Monaco firm as an independent broker for shipowners, operators, shipyards and banks. Its work extends across conventional merchant shipping and specialised offshore, gas, RoRo and car-carrier markets.

Asian shipbuilding prompted the company to establish a Shanghai office with local partners, followed by a base in Seoul. The wider network also includes London and Athens, while Monaco handles sale and purchase, newbuilding and dry-cargo chartering. McLoughlin remains a named contact for the Monaco newbuilding and sale-and-purchase team.
